description: Invalid crash report payloads. SDKs MUST NOT produce these. The receiver SHOULD handle them gracefully (log warning, skip) rather than crash.

payloads.notes: message is required. A payload without it is invalid.
message must have at least 1 character.
environment must be one of the allowed enum values.
payloads.violation: environment not in enum [production, staging, development, test, null]

payloads.notes: platform must be one of the allowed enum values.
payloads.violation: platform not in enum [android, flutter, electron, javascript, rust, go, python, react-native, null]

payloads.notes: additionalProperties is false. Unknown fields are not allowed.
payloads.violation: additionalProperties: user_email, device_id not allowed (also a PII violation)

payloads.notes: message must be a string, not a number.
